An offline evaluation instrument must not carry that blast radius. The operator runs the drill against a green cell.

It sits after only read-only steps (arg parse, order resolution, project.conf load, charset/tmux-name guards) and before the throttle, board_status read, order_pin and every emit (hive-launch:118 onward) — so the refusal precedes any spine write. --anyway (parsed at hive-launch:26) is the escape hatch and warns instead. candidate.patch:9-24 appends the hive-metrics call at the very end of hive-close, strictly after the review.passed / status_override(done) emits and after the existing scoring step. It is the last statement in the file and the group's exit status is the trailing echo's, so hive-close still exits 0 — a successful close never looks failed.
